verdict.rationale: Bento's API and CLI explicitly support bulk operations (1-1000 subscribers per request, bulk create/update without triggering automations, filtering by tags/segments/date ranges, 50+ CLI commands for account management), and these surfaces are accessible to AI agents via MCP/CLI/SDK. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of bulk operation performance/limits at scale and no explicit mention of bulk operations being exposed through the MCP tool interface itself.
